# App tokens

An app token is a resource that provides a mechanism for machine-to-machine
authentication to Boundary. An app token's access is managed by permissions,
which include grants and grant scopes.
You can create app tokens in the [global][], [organization][],
or [project][] [scopes][]. An app token persists even if the [user][]
who creates it is deleted from the system.

You cannot update an app token once created. 
You can read, list, revoke, and delete app tokens.

## Attributes

An app token has the following attributes:

- `id` - (output only) The ID of the app token.

- `scope_id` - The ID of the scope in which the app token was created.

- `scope` - (output only) Information about the scope in which the app
  token was created.

- `token` - (output only) The app token value. This value is only ever
  visible when you create the app token.

- `name` - (optional)
  If set, the `name` must be unique within the app token's scope.

- `description` - (optional)

- `created_by_user_id` - (output only) The ID of the [user][] who created the
  app token.

- `created_time` - (output only) The time the app token was created in Boundary.

- `approximate_last_access_time` - (output only) The approximate time the app
  token was last used.

- `time_to_stale_seconds` - (optional) The maximum period of inactivity
  after which the app token is considered stale and can no longer be used
  for authentication.

- `expiration_time` - (output only) The time the app token expires.

- `status` - (output only) The current status of the app token. Can be one
  of `active`, `stale`, `revoked`, or `expired`.

- `permissions` - The permissions granted to this app token.

- `authorized_actions` - (output only) The actions available to the
  authenticated token.

## Expiration

App tokens can expire based on two parameters:

- `time_to_live_seconds` sets the maximum lifetime of the app token. This parameter is
  used at creation to calculate the `expiration_time` attribute.
  The maximum value for this parameter is 3 years.

- `time_to_stale_seconds` is an optional parameter that sets the maximum period of inactivity of the app token.

You set these parameters on an app token when you create it.

## Permissions

App token grants are intentionally limited in scope. You cannot assign the following
grants to an app token:

- Write actions (`create`, `revoke`, and `delete`) on the app token resource.

- `authorize-session` action on the [target][] resource.

To better understand Boundary's permissions model, refer to [Permissions in Boundary](/boundary/docs/rbac).
